spec_match.rationale: Takes a real trace and checks samples for the marker field against the proposal vocabulary, plus the Document-Policy gate via an srcdoc frame.

interactive.rationale: Both buttons work: the policy-less frame threw NotAllowedError, and the sample button filled the vocabulary table.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers missing header, coarse sampleInterval, and markers defined-but-not-emitted.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite shows 1 PASS / 5 FAIL because /v153/js-self-profiling-markers/conformance/ is served WITHOUT Document-Policy: js-profiling (routes/conformance.ts only special-cases v147), so even profiler construction fails; the concept pages themselves do carry the header.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): unflagged: 0 of 6 markers seen; with --enable-blink-features=ExperimentalJSProfilerMarkers: layout and style seen; the deliberate policy-violation console error appears only after the opt-in button; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.
